name: Verminari
body:
Verminari CR 1/3

XP 135
Veriminari warrior 1
CE Small humanoid (goblinoid)
Init +2; Senses darkvision 40 ft.; Perception +3

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 13, flat-footed 15 (+2 armor, +2 Dex, +1 natural, +1 size)
hp 5 (1d10)
Fort +2, Ref +1, Will –1
Defensive Abilities mirror image

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee spear -1 (1d6–2)
Ranged javelin +3 (1d6-2)

STATISTICS

Str 7; Dex 15; Con 10; Int 10,Wis 9; Cha 8
Base Atk +1; CMB –1; CMD 10
Feats Skill Focus (Perception)
Skills Craft Perception +3, Stealth +6
Languages Common, Goblin

Spell-Like Abilities (Sp)

1/day, mirror image

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate hills or mountains
Organization solitary, gang (2–4), village (5–30), tribe (31-100 plus 1 barbarian or ranger warlord of 6th-8th level)
Treasure standard gear (leather armor, spear, javelin, other treasure)

The verminari are a lesser-known race that bear much in common with the other goblinoid species. Verminari follow a tribal structure and typically wield crude spears and javelins.

Verminari are notable for their mirror image ability, which is innate and regularly used as part of the verminari’s combat strategy. Typically, verminari will use this ability either during the first rounds of combat, or as an escape mechanism to elude superior enemies.

Verminari are bright blue in color, and have wrinkled, leathery hides Their fanged mouths and large ears complete a nearly comical, yet horrific, appearance. The average verminari stands 3 feet tall and weighs 45 pounds.
